name: Son
source:
Lately, an ordinary japanese student Takano Jyun has been having the same dream, where he sees a horrrible sight of the murder of a girl, who was trying to protect him from the attacker. What does this strange dream mean? Trying to find an answer to this question, Takano Jyun gets into a whirlwind of exciting adventures

[Translated from [url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/10-1-0-329]Anivisual[/url]]
